about_short_description.short_description: Unthread is an AI-powered support platform built into Slack.

product.name: Unthread AI Helpdesk
product.description: A cloud-based support and service-management platform that centralizes tickets, AI resolution, knowledge, workflows, analytics, and on-call operations across Slack and other channels.

product.name: Agentic AI
product.description: An AI agent that classifies, routes, answers, and resolves support requests using company knowledge, ticket context, connected tools, and configurable prompts.

product.name: Slack Support
product.description: A Slack-native ticketing product for creating, assigning, tracking, responding to, and closing support conversations directly in channels, DMs, and threads.

product.name: Shared Inbox
product.description: A shared email and Slack inbox that converts incoming messages into collaborative ticket threads and allows teams to reply from Slack.

product.name: Automations
product.description: A workflow automation system for routing tickets, triggering multi-step actions, integrating APIs, and executing operational processes from Slack or other supported channels.

product.name: Knowledge Base
product.description: A self-updating knowledge-management system that uses support conversations and resolved tickets to draft, update, and serve documentation.
